title: 难度系统
description: 难度等级、任务变化、奖励影响

sections.title: Effects
sections.content:
• The number of Medals, Requisition Slips, and Experience you earn from a mission all depends on the difficulty you select.
    • Higher difficulty missions have increasing percentage multipliers for Requisition Slips and Experience, from +25% on Medium to +300% on Super Helldive
    • The Eradication Main Objective base-reward depends on the selected difficulty. Each difficulty affects the rewards by 20 and 100. E.g. Extreme Eradication-mission rewards 120 and 600, and Medium rewards 60 and 300.
  • Enemy forces are enhanced to increasingly lethal degrees.
    • The number of enemies and the type of enemy both depend on the difficulty level set.
    • The frequency of enemy patrol being spawned increases alongside the difficulty.
      • In relation, the frequency of DSS Eagle Strike and other tactical actions during missions decreases with increased difficulty.
  • The number of Operation Modifiers present during the mission.
    • One modifier is added on Hard.
    • A second modifier is added on Impossible.
  • The number of Sub-Objectives required to complete a Main Objective increases at higher difficulties.
  • The number and size of enemy Outposts (Bug Nests/Automaton Outposts/Illuminate Encampments)
    • Outpost spawning can vary quite drastically depending on a number of other factors as well, including biome, mission type, and faction.
  • The number of Optional Objectives increases at higher difficulties.
  • Map size increases to accommodate the increased amount of Mission Objectives on the Expedition-mission. The size increase is lesser on the Metropolis biome maps.
    • As difficulty increases once maximum map-size has been achieved, the Mission Objectives occupy spaces which otherwise might have had Minor Places of Interest being places upon.
  • The number and type of Samples able to be found depends on the set difficulty.
    • Commons appear on all difficulties, while Rares first appear on Challenging, and Supers on Extreme difficulty.
    • The type of samples available during an operation can be confirmed on the Galactic War console when selecting an operation.
